headword: {森羅万象|しんらばんしょう}
gloss: all things in the universe; all of creation; everything

definitions.explanation: Everything that exists in the universe, all phenomena and entities without exception.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仏教|ぶっきょう}→仏教：11428_bukkyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{森羅万象|しんらばんしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無常|むじょう}→無常：13422_mujou⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{説|と}く→説く：14245_toku⟧。
examples.english: Buddhism teaches that all things in the universe are impermanent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{森羅万象|しんらばんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{源|みなもと}→源：27896_minamoto⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Nature is the source of all things in existence.

examples.japanese: {森羅万象|しんらばんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{宿|やど}る→宿る：12351_yadoru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{信|しん}じられていた→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: It was believed that life dwells in all things in the universe.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧):
{森羅|しんら} (dense, countless things) + {万象|ばんしょう} (myriad phenomena)

COMPONENTS:
- {森|しん}: forest, dense
- {羅|ら}: net, to spread out
- {万|ばん}: ten thousand, myriad
- {象|しょう}: phenomenon, form

ORIGIN:
Derived from Buddhist philosophy, particularly the concept that all things are interconnected and part of one universal whole.

USAGE:
Used in philosophical, religious, or literary contexts to refer to the totality of existence. Common in discussions of Buddhism, Shinto, or nature.

CULTURAL CONNECTION:
Relates to the Japanese concept of ⟦{万物|ばんぶつ}→万物：20516_banbutsu⟧ (all things) and the Shinto belief that spirits (⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧) inhabit all natural phenomena.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{万物|ばんぶつ}→万物：20516_banbutsu⟧: all things
- ⟦{宇宙|うちゅう}→宇宙：01861_uchuu⟧: the universe
- ⟦{天地万物|てんちばんぶつ}→天地万物：29296_tenchibanbutsu⟧: all things in heaven and earth
